messages:
jess_sales: Brighton signed — passing to CS for activation. Quick context: they want a Private deployment (VPC peering), Okta SSO, HIPAA/BAA required. Target go-live ~2026-05-10 (about 6w). Expected ingest ~2TB/day, peak ~200 qps on search/embeddings. Sales notes: they'd prefer bundled Dedicated if unit cost fits; contract has a conditional commit. I created provisioning ticket RED-3219 and attached the contract link: https://redwood.app/contracts/BRIGHTON-2026. Assigning owners below.
mike_cs: Thanks Jess — good context. @anya_support can you own infra validation (VPC, peering, certs)? @liam_eng can you triage capacity vs. Dedicated need? @sam_ops please own BAA/legal loop. Also need SSO metadata + at least 2 test users from Brighton IT (okta_admin@brighton.org).
anya_support: I can take infra validation. I'll run the VPC checklist and open a peering request. Deliverables: network diagram, peering ticket, cert thumbprints. ETA 4 business days. Link to our checklist: https://redwood.app/docs/onboarding/vpc-checklist
liam_eng: I'll run a capacity sketch. With 2TB/day and 200 qps peak we might be able to stay hosted with aggressive batching + quantization for embeddings. If latency >200ms under load we recommend Dedicated. I'll spin up a mock load and create ENG-9042 to track. ETA 3 days.
jess_sales: FYI contract notes: 10% discount if they commit to 12mo Reserved capacity; they flagged PHI redaction + moderation as must-have for go-live. POC asks: semantic search/embeddings and reranking for clinical content.
mike_cs: Plan of record (owners):
 - Collect SSO metadata + 2 test users (Owner: jess_sales)
 - Infra validation / VPC peering (Owner: anya_support)
 - Capacity triage + ENG-9042 (Owner: liam_eng)
 - BAA/legal review (Owner: sam_ops)
 - Enablement session + evaluation checklist (Owner: mike_cs)
I'll create a CS playbook and a single tracking ticket RED-CS-6021. Obj: have basic infra + SSO working and run first eval within 2 weeks. Anyone object? :thumbsup:
anya_support: Quick Q — is this VPC-peering to our managed private plane or full on-prem package? Sales said VPC peering to our private control plane. I'll confirm whether they need static IPs or VPN.
liam_eng: Note on triage: I'll test with model-medium and quantized-medium configs first. If we can meet latency with caching/kv and batching we avoid Dedicated. If not, cost delta estimate will be in ENG-9042. Also will validate embeddings throughput and memory footprints.
sam_ops: Legal/Compliance: acknowledged. I'll loop in legal and send a BAA draft to Brighton by EOD Friday. Also will prepare a compliance checklist for CS and Support to sign off.
mike_cs: Capture of customer feedback / POC asks: Brighton wants a demo on PHI redaction + moderation rules, plus an evaluation on hallucination rates with their sample corpus. Request: Jess please ask Brighton for a small anonymized sample dataset (SFTP link or S3) and Okta test creds.
jess_sales: Will request anonymized sample + Okta metadata today and drop into RED-CS-6021. Also confirm their IT contact: marie.smith@brighton.org.
mike_cs: I'll calendar a kickoff enablement session (30m) and include an enablement agenda: SSO walkthrough, infra checklist, PHI redaction demo, evaluation plan. Tentative sync: Thu 10am PT. Final action owners summary posted to tracking ticket. Closing notes: tracking ticket https://redwood.app/ops/RED-CS-6021 — Owners: jess_sales / mike_cs / anya_support / liam_eng / sam_ops. Follow-up in-thread or on RED-CS-6021. :white_check_mark:
